user.title: Log Assist transcripts and intents
user.description: Stores full text and structured results locally in config/intent_logger, never audio. Logs and optional failure events can contain private information. Uses internal Assist APIs; verify compatibility before upgrading Home Assistant. Empty pipeline selection captures all pipelines.

data.ignore_duplicate_wake_ups: Ignore duplicate wake-ups when firing failure events

init.title: Intent Logger options
init.description: Changes reload logging. Empty pipeline selection captures all pipelines, including future ones. Size limits may remove logs before their retention period. Failure events expose the same private text to automations and potentially Recorder.

data.ignore_duplicate_wake_ups: Ignore duplicate wake-ups when firing failure events
